description: Ethereum fee market from our own Reth node: current and next base fee, priority-fee percentiles over the last blocks, and the estimated ETH cost of a plain transfer and of an ERC-20 transfer. When to use: pricing an Ethereum transaction, or deciding what tip gets included quickly. Do not use: for Bitcoin (btc_get_fee_rates), Monero (xmr_get_fee_rates) or Tron (tron_get_chain_economics). Returns: base_fee_gwei, next_base_fee_gwei, base_fee_last_blocks_gwei, priority_percentiles_gwei, estimated_cost{simple_eth_transfer_21000_gas_eth, erc20_transfer_65000_gas_eth}.
name: eth_get_fee_rates
title: Eth Get Fee Rates
